article.headline: Aeneas Alexander scores 22 as North Texas routs Southwestern Christian 122-50 in opener
article.description: — Aeneas Alexander scored 22 points and North Texas beat Southwestern Christian 122-50 on Monday night in a season opener.
article.linkText: Aeneas Alexander scores 22 as North Texas routs Southwestern Christian 122-50 in opener

keywords: Southwestern Christian U Eagles @ North Texas Mean Green
article.story: DENTON, Texas -- — Aeneas Alexander scored 22 points and North Texas beat Southwestern Christian 122-50 on Monday night in a season opener. Alexander added nine rebounds for the Mean Green. Casmir Chavis added 17 points and Amar Amkou scored 16. Jayden Cox finished with 17 points to lead the Eagles. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
